description: GroupMe is a group messaging service. Its developer platform lets apps access groups, messages, bots, image uploads, and realtime message events for GroupMe accounts.
summary: GroupMe exposes three documented developer surfaces on GroupMe-owned hosts: the REST API at `api.groupme.com/v3`, the image upload API at `image.groupme.com`, and the Bayeux-based push service at `push.groupme.com/faye`; all require GroupMe-issued credentials.
